Contract-before-edit for routing-overlay-complete-state-retirement:
1. Producer/Consumer Symbols:
   - Producers: SQLQueryEngineRoutingMetadataMethods.refreshAuthoritativeRoutingOverlay, handleAuthoritativeRoutingOverlayCacheApplyChange, evictOutdatedAuthoritativeRoutingOverlayEntry, syncAuthoritativeRoutingOverlaySurvivingServices, initializeSqlQueryEngineInstance, detachAuthoritativeRoutingOverlayCacheApplyListener.
   - Consumers: QueryExecutor.getPartitionServiceRows, getRoutablePartitionServices, getPartitionRoutingSnapshot, SQLQueryEngine.getAuthoritativeRoutingOverlayServices, shouldAuthoritativeRoutingOverlayMaskCacheServices.
2. Owner-Defined Shape:
   - Routing overlay entry holds { state, partition, services, cacheServiceState, capturedCacheBaseline }.
   - capturedCacheBaseline snapshots cache partition and service map at overlay installation.
3. Identity/Generation & Currency:
   - overRefTs is resolved as the maximum timestamp across overlay partition and services.
   - Cache currency check isAuthoritativeOverlayOutdated evaluates isAvailableOverlayOutdated.
   - When an overlay is in MASKED state (entry.cacheServiceState !== ELIGIBLE), it masks stale cached rows excluded from authority.
   - Any service in curr.svcs that is excluded from overServices (!Object.hasOwn(overServices, id)) and has not advanced beyond overRefTs (!isNewerTs(updated_at, overRefTs)) constitutes an un-deleted stale cached service.
   - While any such stale cached service remains, partial advances of surviving services or partition metadata do NOT retire the overlay. Surviving service rows and partition metadata that advance in cache are synchronized into the overlay to route with current addresses/roles while continuing to mask excluded stale routes.
4. Complete Authority Progress & Deletion/Recreation:
   - Once all excluded stale services are deleted from cache (or all cached services are genuinely newer than overRefTs), genuine cache convergence or newer complete authority cleanly retires the overlay.
   - Partition deletion in cache (curr.part === null && Object.keys(curr.svcs).length === 0 && base.part !== null or CDC DELETE on TABLES.PARTITIONS) evicts lingering overlays, ensuring clean recreation.
5. Subscription & Refresh Cleanup:
   - In-flight refreshes are deduplicated via inFlightAuthoritativeRoutingRefreshes.
   - Engine shutdown and cache replacement clear in-flight refreshes and detach listeners; pending refreshes abort/return false and cannot leak entries into shut-down or re-bound engines.

Repaired routing overlay currency and lifecycle in src/query/sql-query-engine-routing-metadata-methods.js and src/query/sql-query-engine-instance-initializer.js:
1. Prevented premature overlay retirement under mixed-age cache updates: Added hasUndeletedStaleServices to detect cached services excluded from authoritative overlay that have not advanced beyond overRefTs. While such un-deleted stale rows remain, isAvailableOverlayOutdated refuses retirement.
2. Synchronized surviving services and partition updates into active overlays: Implemented syncAuthoritativeRoutingOverlaySurvivingServices to propagate updated addresses/roles for active services and partition records from cache into the overlay while maintaining masking over excluded stale routes.
3. Supported partition drop eviction: Handled partition deletions via CDC DELETE and empty-state detection so partition drop immediately purges overlay entries, allowing clean recreation.
4. Hardened lifecycle and in-flight refresh cleanup: Added inFlightAuthoritativeRoutingRefreshes deduplication and cancellation on engine shutdown and cache replacement, guaranteeing no post-shutdown overlay state leaks.
5. Verified via dedicated unit/integration witness test/query/routing-overlay-complete-state-retirement.test.js and evidence harness scripts/quest-evidence/routing-overlay-complete-state-retirement.js (red-to-green proof on 5/6 receipts, with independent verification ready for subagent review).
